messages:
Maya C: Heads up — family emergency came up, I can't cover the EU midnight shifts this weekend (Sat->Sun). I'm the scheduled primary 23:00-07:00 CET. Need someone to pick up primary and a backup for both nights. Apologies for the short notice.
Oncall Bot: @channel Automated reminder: please confirm on-call swaps at least 8h before shift start. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-night-oncall
Liam R: I can take primary for Sat night (22:30–06:30 CET). I'm US-based but can stay awake. Need a secondary for Sat.
Sophie (oncall): I can be secondary for Sat, and switch to primary Sun if needed. @Andre can you be secondary for Sun?
Andre: I can do Sun secondary. Not ideal overnight but I'll take pages if they come.
Maya C: Thank you — couple quick notes about risk: there's a prod deploy Friday 18:00 CET (team POSTERITY) that often causes transient 502/503 spikes. Please watch the deploy health checks and model-serving metrics. Full handoff checklist in the runbook but pasting essentials below.

```
Handoff checklist (quick):
- Confirm calendar invites + phone routing (PagerDuty)
- Check scheduled deploys: prod-deploy v3.4 @ Fri 18:00 CET
- Pre-warm key endpoints (embed-server-prod, model-serving-prod-1)
- Watch 5xx > 0.5% over 5m -> open bridge #incident-bridge
- If customer impact (SLA errors) -> tag @Ops SRE and open P0 channel
- Bridge template: /join #incident-bridge -> post summary + logs link
```

Eva G: I've added calendar invites and updated the rotation spreadsheet (https://redwood.internal/oncall/rotation). Liam — invite sent as primary Sat. Sophie/Andre invites for Sun roles. Pinned runbook to the channel. :white_check_mark:
Oncall Bot: Tip: enable mobile push for PagerDuty on-call notifications if you haven't.
Liam R: Quick question: what's our standard confirmation cutoff on last-minute swaps? I assume 12h, but wanted to confirm.
Sophie (oncall): We usually ask for 8h confirmation for swaps, 12h if it's a multi-day block. Given short notice, let's confirm by 18:00 CET Friday. I'll take point to escalate if anyone drops.
Ops SRE: Confirmed — escalation policy is healthy and webhooks tested this morning. If you need a manual failover to Dedicated capacity or region fallback, ping me and I'll action.
Andre: Note for whoever is primary: prefix/KV cache warmups can cause a flurry of token churn post-deploy. If you see kvcache-thrash in logs, consider throttling background batchers for 10-15m.
Maya C: I'll drop my quick personal notes into the handoff doc (known flaky endpoints, past mitigations). Thanks so much all of you. Please react with :raised_hands: when you confirm.
Liam R: :raised_hands:
Sophie (oncall): :raised_hands:
Andre: :raised_hands:
Eva G: :white_check_mark:
Oncall Bot: Reminder logged: swap requested by Maya C. If anything changes, update rotation spreadsheet and notify #eng-oncall.
